thread:
alice-cs: P0 from Acme — customers seeing 503s when they call the tool endpoint, started ~10:15 UTC. They say it happens during tool-invocations with large file attachments.
sara-support: Getting stack traces from customer now, they're hitting timeouts after ~12s and then 503 from gateway.
ben-oncall: I'm on it, routing to eng-sre. Any spike in qps?
observability-bot: Alert: hosted-infer-gateway 5xx rate +420% in last 5m, p95 latency +200ms. Links: https://console/redwood/alerts/677890
angela-sre: Looking at runner logs, I see repeated process exits in upstream-infer-runner: `Signal 11 (SIGSEGV)` then container restart.
mike-ml: Any GPU OOM logs? This smells like kernel OOM or coredump on CUDA kernel.
ajordan-plat-eng: We just released a batchmap change yesterday — could be related. deploy-bot: deployment v2026.03.16-batchmap tweak -> rolled at 04:03 UTC.
alice-cs: Customer timeline lines up with after that deploy. They started using a toolcall that triggers a big KV prefetch.
sara-support: Customer repro snippet they sent: `curl -X POST /v1/tools/run -d '{"file":"<10MB base64>", "prompt":"very long"}'` -> 503 after about 12s.
angela-sre: Grabbed the container stderr — here's the crash tail: ````
2026-03-16T10:16:12Z infer-runner[2435]: internal error: c10_cuda::CUDAError: out of memory at aten/src/ATen/cuda/CUDAFunctions.cpp:112
2026-03-16T10:16:12Z infer-runner[2435]: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
2026-03-16T10:16:12Z infer-runner[2435]: Aborted (core dumped)
````
ben-oncall: That looks like GPU OOM -> uncontrolled. Why SIGSEGV also earlier? Could be post-OOM pagefault. Need full coredump + nvcrash logs.
mike-ml: Hypothesis: toolcall expands context by prefetching large auxiliary tensors, combined with dynamic batching leads to memory compaction failure. Repro on a small staging node with same model and a single heavy toolcall.
ajordan-plat-eng: I can reproduce locally with the customer's payload on a dev-gpu-1 box. Process dies when prefetch tries to allocate additional 6GB on top of active KV cache.
angela-sre: Short mitigation: route tool calls to a lower-capacity-compatible variant (quantized model) or disable batching for that route. I can add a temporary policy to gateway.
ben-oncall: Do it. Add fallback to model:v1-quantized and disable dynbatch on route /v1/tools/run for the next 2h.
observability-bot: Routing policy change applied by angela-sre at 10:32 UTC -> fallback model v1-quantized.
alice-cs: Customer confirmed errors dropped to near zero after the fallback. They can accept degraded quality for now. :relieved:
sara-support: Need postmortem checklist: reproduce, root cause (prefetch + dynbatch), fix options (prefetch cap, OOM handling, queue backpressure), and alerting improvements for pre-OOM signals.
mike-ml: Repro steps I used: ````
# on dev-gpu-1
export PAYLOAD='{"file":"<customer-base64>", "prompt":"long context..."}'
curl -sS -X POST http://dev-infer.local/v1/tools/run -d "$PAYLOAD" --max-time 20
````
Kill reproducer produced dmesg lines: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus` and `segfault` in runner.
ajordan-plat-eng: I grabbed full core + `gdb --batch -ex "bt full" --pid 2435` output and uploaded to /var/tmp/incident-677890.
angela-sre: Next actions: (1) Add prefetch size limit per-tool (2) Defensive OOM handler: catch allocation failures and fail fast with 429 rather than crash (3) Add on-host nvml watcher to detect rising GPU mem and trigger backpressure 80->90% threshold.
ben-oncall: Assign owners — angela for runtime OOM handler, mike for prefetch policy, jordan for infra watcher + reproducer artifacts. I'll schedule a postmortem doc.
alice-cs: Customer requested ETA for permanent fix; can we give a timeline?
mike-ml: Quick fix (prefetch cap) in 6-12 hours, runtime OOM handler next week, infra watcher EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.03.16-oom-mitigation -> started 11:00 UTC (route-level prefetch cap).
observability-bot: Metric: hosted-infer-gateway 5xx rate back to baseline at 10:40 UTC after fallback.
sara-support: Closing loop with customer — send summary + temporary mitigation + ETA for permanent fix.
angela-sre: Saving logs, core, and nvcrash artifacts to the incident bundle at s3://redwood-incident-bundles/677890/ (links in the postmortem).
ben-oncall: Thanks all. We'll follow up in the postmortem with root cause and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
alice-cs: Customer happy for now. Marking this P0 -> P1 for follow-up work.
